description.text: Grants [Rousing Charge Mode (Fire, Lightning, Earth)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Master], [Crowning Strike Damage Tracker] and [Crowning Strike Level]

description.name: Rousing Charge Mode (Fire, Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth] after using a Fire/Lightning/Earth ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Master
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Crowning Strike (0~2), removed after using Crowning Strike two times

description.name: Crowning Strike Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Crowning Strike level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Master]

description.name: Crowning Strike Level
description.text: Keeps track of Crowning Strike level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Master]
